name: io.github.olafkfreund/myrmex-hive
description: Myrmex Hive: a zero-inbound-port MCP gateway for managing distributed edge servers. Agents dial out to a central Gateway over SSH; the Gateway exposes their tools (run_command, get_metrics, read_logs, get_system_info) as namespaced MCP tools over stdio, HTTP/SSE, and a REST API, with RBAC, scoped tokens, risk-tiered approvals, and a signed audit log.

environment_variables.name: MYRMEX_GATEWAY_CONFIG
environment_variables.description: Path to gateway_config.json inside the container
